name: microverse
description: Run a project as missions delegated to background agents: one task, one branch, one worktree.

week_target.title: End-of-week target (%)
week_target.description: Consumption aimed at the weekly reset; beyond it agents are no longer resumed, and no new agent starts 3 points before.

weekday_reserve.title: Weekday reserve (%)
weekday_reserve.description: Points kept for weekdays; the weekend may rise to the target minus this value.

five_hour_limit.title: 5h counter threshold (%)
five_hour_limit.description: Beyond it, no new agent until the 5h counter resets; 5 points higher, no more resuming.

compact_window.title: Auto-compact window (tokens)
compact_window.description: Context size at which Claude Code compacts the orchestrating conversation; /microverse:init writes compact_window + 33000 as autoCompactWindow in .claude/settings.local.json, because Claude Code compacts about 33K below that setting.

quota_file.title: Quota counters file
quota_file.description: quota-observations-v2.json of the VS Code extension "Claude Code Usage". Empty: the extension's default location.
